topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: My words, the ones I poured into the night, now float in the open. They were meant to be a secret, a whisper only to the ears that mattered. But now, they circle like vultures, exposed to all. I never wanted this, never asked for eyes to pry, for judgments to cloud the clear sky I reached for. Can I gather these scattered leaves, press them back into the pages of my silence? The path forward is thorny, each step a risk. Yet, moving back is not an option; the way is blocked. So, I stand here, under the harsh sun, and try to shape the storm into something that might carry me on, not tear me apart.
